Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 

COUPLINGS FOR DISPOSAL OF OILY MIXTURE 

FOR INLAND VESSELS 

PART 1 FLANGE COUPLINGS 



( Reaffirmed 2002 ) 



1. Scope 

i.1 This standard iays down the requirements for fiange couplings to connect storage containers to 
the piping for the disposal of oily mixture from inland vessels. 

2. Dimensions 

2.1 The dimensions of the couplings shall be as given in Fig. 1. 

Note — The flange is designed for tubes of Internal diameter up to 125 mm.

FIG. 1 COUPLING FLANGE FOR THE DISPOSAL OF OILY MIXTURE 

2.2 The internal diameter D x of flange shall be chosen according to the outside diameter of the tube. 
2 3 The connection of flanges shall be made with bolts -of M20 and of appropriate length. 

3. Materials 

3.1 The parts of couplings shall be manufactured of steel or other equivalent material. If the flash 
point of the oil vapours in the oily mixture is lower than 60*C, the parts shall be manufactured from 
non-sparking materials. 

4. General Requirements 

4.1 The limit deviations of the dimensions and the surface roughness of couplings shall meet all 
requirements and the necessity of ensuring leak-proof joints.

4.2 The conventional pressure for flange coupling shall be 0*6 MPa*» 

5. Designation 

5.1 The flange couplings shall be designated by the following: 

a) Name of the coupling; 

b) Number of standard; and 

c) Group of the coupling ( Ax for flange couplings for oily mixture ). 

Example : A flange coupling conforming to this standard shall be designated as follows: 
Flange IS : 11823 ( Parti ) —A x 

6. Marking 

6.1 The couplings shall be marked with manufacturer's name and designation. 
6.1.1 Certification Marking — Details available with the Bureau of Indian Standards. 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

This standard gives the requirements for couplings for disposal of oily mixture used for inland 
vessels. The type of coupling is chosen depending upon the use of vessels and the system of pollu- 
ted water transfer and treatment adopted in its operational area. 

This standard is being issued in the following four parts: 

Part 1 Flange couplings, 

Part 2 Quick-release couplings, 

Part 3 Adapter — Flange/end-piece, and 

Part 4 Adapter — Flange/bush. 

Vessels of 'river/sea' type are equipped with fixed flange coupling as given in this part of the 
standard. 

Not withstanding what is stated in this standard, the rules and requirements laid down by the 
Classification Societies and Statutory Authorities in ail respects shall prevail. 

This standard is based on ISO 7608-1985 'Shipbuilding — inland navigation — couplings for 
disposal of oily mixture and sewage water', issued by the International Organization for Standardi- 
zation ( ISO ). The ISO standard classifies the couplings for oily mixture under Group A and further 
sub-classifies the flange couplings as Type 1. The same method of classification is used in this 
standard for the sake of uniformity.
